lectori-gowland-n1.raw: If somebody provokes me, I shout, ‘Better not touch!’ {Horace}

lectori-gowland-n2.raw: I was summoned to cure Democritus, who was apparently insane; but when I met him, by god, I discovered his work wasn’t foolish, but was a storehouse of all truths, and I was astonished at his genius. Indeed, I accused the Abderitans of being just as insane, saying it was rather they that needed a dose of hellebore.
